sections.title: What Shard is
items: Shard is an unofficial Minecraft launcher. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang or Microsoft.
Playing online and changing skins needs a Minecraft license: the launcher doesn't bypass anything.
The launcher is provided as is, without warranty. Keep backups of worlds you care about.

sections.title: Mods and modpacks
items: Mods, modpacks, resource packs and shaders belong to their authors and are downloaded from Modrinth and CurseForge under their rules.
If an author disallows downloads from apps, Shard opens the file page so you can download it yourself.

sections.title: Your data
items: Accounts and sign-in tokens are stored only on this computer, in the launcher folder.
Shard talks to Microsoft and Mojang (sign-in, skins, the game), Modrinth and CurseForge (search and downloads), Discord (status, if enabled) and api.ipify.org (server address for friends).
The launcher collects no analytics and sends nothing to the developer.

sections.title: Servers
items: By running a server you accept the Minecraft EULA and are responsible for what happens on it.
Internet access opens a port on your router (UPnP) only while the server is running.
